_editor: Working editorial draft. John reviews all copy and evidence before publication. Null values are slots for the editor. Use only approved entries in public builds.

profile.name: John Manuel
profile.intro: I’m John, a mechatronics student at Waterloo. I like the point in a build where a drawing, a few wires and some code finally do something together.
profile.tagline: I build things where mechanics, electronics and code meet.

aboutNotebook.label: Sketch
aboutNotebook.prompt: Which constraint changed the gantry design? Include a sketch.

aboutNotebook.label: Build
aboutNotebook.prompt: Which part did you contribute? Show the matching build or CAD view.

aboutNotebook.label: Test
aboutNotebook.prompt: What did you try, what did you observe, and what changed?

projects.title: Insulin tracker
projects.summary: An app that helps my grandmother keep track of her insulin.
projects.editorPrompt: Screen recording of logging a dose, or a photo of the app in her hands.

projects.title: RC vehicles
projects.editorPrompt: Photo or clip of a car with the shell off. Export the SolidWorks assembly as GLB for a 3D exploded view.

projects.title: WireTrace
projects.summary: Plan a breadboard layout and see where each jumper goes.
projects.editorPrompt: Show one circuit in the visualizer, then show what changed when a pin assignment was corrected.
projects.heroAlt: WireTrace visualizer tracing the M1 Ground net: an Arduino, breadboard, servo and supply with every connected pin circled in orange.
projects.heroCaption: Visualizer · tracing the M1 Ground net

projects.title: Humline
projects.summary: Hum a melody and turn it into MIDI.
projects.editorPrompt: Pair a short original recording with its MIDI output, then describe a pitch-detection decision.
projects.heroAlt: Humline piano roll showing six notes from C4 to C5 under the waveform of the source audio.
projects.heroCaption: Piano roll · synthetic example, not a recorded hum

projects.title: FaceTracekr
projects.summary: Explore how head movement and intentional winks can control a cursor.
projects.editorPrompt: Show one intentional wink alongside a normal blink. Describe how you assessed responsiveness.

projects.title: Tower of Hanoi gantry
projects.summary: Design a gantry and gripper to move four Tower of Hanoi pieces.
projects.editorPrompt: Show the horizontal carriage and vertical lift. Credit teammates and identify John’s part.

goals.title: A balancing delivery robot
goals.question: Can a two-wheel robot carry an envelope across an office and stay balanced?
goals.proposedNextExperiment: Simulate balancing with a representative payload.
goals.successCriterionToSet: Choose a payload and measurable balance criterion before the first trial.

goals.title: Hands-free interaction
goals.question: How can someone tell whether their wink was detected during calibration?
goals.proposedNextExperiment: Compare two visual feedback cues during calibration.

origin.title: It started with my grandmother.
origin.body: She needed a simpler way to keep track of her insulin, so I built her an app. It was the first time something I made mattered to someone.
origin.photoPrompt: Photo: the insulin tracker on a phone, or you with your grandmother

origin.title: Then things started moving.
origin.body: RC cars taught me that code is only half the story. Motors, gears and batteries all get a vote.
origin.photoPrompt: Photo: an RC car on the bench, shell off

origin.title: Now I do it properly.
origin.body: I study Mechatronics Engineering at the University of Waterloo, where mechanics, electronics and software are one subject.
origin.photoPrompt: Photo: you on campus or in the lab
